emailVerified.description: Whether the account has completed email verification.

csrfToken.description: Session-bound CSRF token. Send it in the x-csrf-token header on every state-changing request. Fetch a fresh one from GET /v1/auth/me after a page reload.
Session-bound CSRF token. Send it in the x-csrf-token header on every state-changing request. Fetch a fresh one from GET /v1/auth/me after a page reload.

isOperator.description: Whether the account currently has a non-revoked platform operator grant.

signInMethods.description: The sign-in methods currently linked to this account.

nonce.description: Short-lived value to pass to Google Identity Services.

expiresAt.description: When this challenge stops being usable.

idToken.description: Google Identity Services ID token. Used exactly as supplied.

password.description: Between 8 and 128 Unicode code points. Never trimmed or normalized.

displayName.description: Trimmed once by the server; the trimmed value must be 1 to 100 Unicode code points.

email.description: The normalized (lower-case) address the account is stored under.

emailVerified.description: Always false for a new account. Verification has been requested, not completed.

verificationEmailScheduled.description: The verification request was committed durably with the account. It does not mean an email has already been sent.

token.description: The token from the verification link, exactly as it appeared in the query string.

emailVerified.description: Always true. The address is verified; no session is created and no cookie is set.

accepted.description: Always true. It means the request was accepted, never that an account exists or that an email was sent.

token.description: The token from the reset link, exactly as it appeared in the query string.

password.description: The new password: between 8 and 128 Unicode code points. Never trimmed or normalized.

passwordReset.description: Always true. The password was replaced and every session revoked; no session is created and no cookie is set.

currentPassword.description: Required for accounts with a password.

googleIdToken.description: Required only when the account has no password.

currentPassword.description: Required for accounts with a password.

googleIdToken.description: Required only when the account has no password.

offsetMinutes.description: Required for a custom lock; a preset already fixes its own offset.

markets.description: All seven official markets, each exactly once. Omit this section entirely to take the defaults.
All seven official markets, each exactly once. Omit this section entirely to take the defaults.

correctionUpdating.description: True while an official fact correction is still recalculating this fixture.

value.description: The accepted answer for this market, using the same market-specific shape as the submission endpoint.

playerTeamId.description: The player's team; for an own goal, not the team awarded the goal.

previewToken.description: Signed preview token returned by the preview endpoint.
